facts.text: Millington grew around a new train station when villagers moved to avoid rising waters, giving the town its name.
The city hosts Naval Support Activity Mid‑South, one of Tennessee’s largest employers, with over 7,500 staff on nearly 2,000 acres.
In 1903 Millington was incorporated, but its roots trace back to the 1880s when the railroad first reached the area.
The former Memphis Naval Air Station, now Naval Support Activity Mid‑South, shifted from a pilot training base in 1993 to an administrative hub.
Millington’s First Baptist Church, founded in 1888, now serves more than 5,000 members, making it one of the largest congregations in the region.
During World War II a munitions factory built by Dupont de Nemours near Millington produced TNT and smokeless powder for Allied forces.
